request.question: What are the escalation steps and response targets for a SEV-1 incident?

response.answer: The on-call engineer escalates to the Incident Commander for every SEV-1. [1] The Incident Commander escalates to the VP of Platform Engineering if a SEV-1 lasts longer than 30 minutes. [1] For SEV-1 incidents the first status page update must be published within 15 minutes of declaration. [1] SEV-1 incidents require acknowledgement within 5 minutes and a status update every 30 minutes. [2]
